account:
This morning I read my appointment book and kept the ten o'clock visit to the mill, but I have not found the miller or obtained grain stocks and delivery records, so the inspection remains incomplete. The baker also reported being unable to find the miller earlier. I do not know why the miller is absent.

The unusual thing is the repeated, vague talk of a 'bridge or port change.' Townsfolk near the mill and bakery have repeated it, referring to both the bakery and the inn. Townsfolk 01 said the baker, freight and neighbour were at the bakery, but that does not establish that any of them made a change or even witnessed one. I have asked for specific changes and the original source; no concrete explanation has reached me. I have seen no changed infrastructure myself. This may be circulating news or rumour about transport arrangements, but its purpose and accuracy remain unknown.

The builder requested jobs earlier, but I have authorized no inspections, repairs or spending. The secretary reports no new council letters or office requests. The baker asked about gatherings needing bread, but I know of no confirmed public gathering or bread order; my three o'clock tea with the neighbour is private, not a town catering request. I am now inside the bakery area, with no baker in sight, and my next scheduled appointment is lunch at home at noon, followed by council letters at the office at one.
